name: THE FIVE KEYS: BEYOND THE LOCK
subtitle: BEYOND THE LOCK
label: THE ORIGINAL ADVENTURE
heroAlt: The original Godot Jewel hub, waterfall, portal road and five-key final door.
headline: Five roles. One adventure.
description: Step through the portals. Discover your strengths. Bring the waterfall back to life.
introText: Buildings start with people. Try five roles, from finding a hidden pipe clash to checking finished work.
storyText: The waterfall has stopped. Follow five portals and solve each construction challenge to earn a key. Open the final door and bring the water back.
storyAlt: Glowing role portals along the original Godot adventure road.
steps: Play the five roles in order.
Solve all five challenges to open the final door.
Reach the balcony, align the flow gear and bring the water back.
missionIntro: Five playable missions. Choose a role to see your task and how to finish it.

missions.title: Shrink & Fix
missions.objective: Shrink into the apartment service space and resolve the pipe–duct clash.
missions.success: Restore clearance, then open the handover tablet to record your BIM result and earn the key.
missions.tag: SEE THE BIG PICTURE. GO SMALL.
missions.description: Enter an apartment and shrink through a low hatch. Find the blue pipe crossing an orange air duct, then move its route to clear the clash.
actions: Explore the apartment and ceiling services.
Shrink to reach the hidden pipe-and-duct clash.
Reroute the pipe and open the handover report.
missions.learning: Plan space, fit services together and check your work.
missions.alt: Godot BIM mission showing the pipe and duct coordination challenge.
missions.setting: A residential apartment and its ceiling-service space.
missions.futureEffect: The pipe must fit beside other services. Check the new route after fixing the clash.

missions.title: Crane & Place
missions.objective: Read the lifting plan and place all three PPVC modules in their correct bays and orientations.
missions.success: Clear the lifting zone and safely secure P01, P02 and P03 in the matching A1, A2 and B1 bays.
missions.description: Read the lifting plan and keep the lift zone clear. Match three modules to their bays, turn them the right way and lower them into place.
actions: Read the PPVC module number and target bay.
Check the lift zone before moving the load.
Guide, rotate and place all three modules.
missions.learning: Read plans, lift safely and place loads with care.
missions.alt: The Godot crane mission with a module suspended above its target bay.
missions.setting: A PPVC installation area with numbered modules and drawing bays.
missions.futureEffect: The module number, bay and direction must match the plan.

missions.title: Spec Detective
missions.objective: Compare the model with the approved training drawing and correct the pipe, door and pump data.
missions.success: All three technical details match the supplied drawing.
missions.description: Compare the digital model with the approved training drawing. Find and fix three details that do not match.
actions: Check the pipe diameter against the drawing.
Match the pump flow to the training specification.
missions.learning: Use drawings to check model data.
missions.alt: The Godot technical mission drawing and model data checking interface.
missions.setting: A digital-model checking station beside the training drawing.
missions.futureEffect: Small data errors can affect later work. Check the model against the drawing.

missions.title: Plan the Build
missions.objective: Put construction tasks in the correct order and keep useful work moving during a delivery delay.
missions.success: Prepare the base → lift the PPVC module → connect services → inspect and release. During the delay, choose to prepare the next empty bay.
missions.description: Put the work in order. When a delivery is late, choose another task that is ready to start.
actions: Prepare the base before lifting the module.
Connect services, then inspect and release.
Use the delay to prepare the next empty bay.
missions.learning: Plan the order of work and handle delays.
missions.alt: The Godot planning mission showing the construction sequence choices.
missions.setting: A construction-sequence board and the next available work bay.
missions.futureEffect: Start work only when the earlier tasks are done. A delay is no reason to skip a step.

missions.title: Build & Check
missions.objective: Inspect the finished room, correct three defects and verify the repairs before handover.
missions.success: Align the window frame, close the pipe-opening gap and correct the door tag, then choose “Reinspect then release”.
missions.description: Find a frame gap, an unsealed pipe opening and a wrong door tag. Record each defect, choose a fix and check the work again.
actions: Find and record all three defects.
Reinspect the corrected work before release.
missions.learning: Find defects, fix them and check the repairs.
missions.alt: Godot QAQC gameplay inspecting a residential room for defects.
missions.setting: A finished room ready for its handover check.
missions.futureEffect: Finding a defect is the first step. Fix it, then return to check the repair.

gameplayText: Play in your browser on a desktop or laptop, using a keyboard and mouse or an Xbox controller.

afterGame.title:
PLAY. LEARN.
FIND YOUR NEXT STEP.
afterGame.intro: At the open house, we plan to give you a report card and a role badge. Your report links your game results to roles and study options to explore.
afterGame.reportCaption: Example Godot report · demonstration results, not a student’s personal report.
reportSteps: See where your game decisions stood out and how they connect to construction roles.
Learn about each role and think about what interests you. Your results can help start a career conversation.
Use your report to discuss subjects and courses with a BCA Academy course adviser.
afterGame.reportNote: The demo compares decision accuracy for Site, Technical, Planning and QAQC. BIM completion is recorded separately. Printed report cards and study guidance are planned for the open house.

paths.focus: Digital models and how building services fit together.
Building methods, basic engineering and site teamwork.
Drawings, model data and digital construction.
Planning work, schedules and site teams.
Checking building work against the drawings and requirements.

afterGame.pathwayNote: These are suggested courses to explore. Check the official pages for entry requirements and speak with a course adviser about study and work experience.
afterGame.badgeText: A role badge is planned as a keepsake with your report card. Each of the five designs represents a construction role.
afterGame.badgeCaption: 3D previews of the five badge designs. Photos will be added when finished badges are ready.
